nom: Clinique Moisture Surge Active Glow Serum with Hyaluronic Acid

avis.texte: This is a super moisturizer, great for under eyes, feel soft and velvety on the skin.
I like this gentle moisturizing serum. It does not irritate and makes my skin look glowing. It absorbs quickly leaving skin feeling soft, not sticky.
This Vitamin C serum is great for my sensitive and dry skin making it glowy, nourished and healthy. It also brightens dark spots on my face. I have already used the second one.
Tried a sample size before buying the full size and I loved it. Love how my skin feel so silky smooth and moisturized!
I have a bottle if this and every time I applied this after my toner it irritates my skin. I puechased centella to appy before for irritation but it won't help.
It is easy to apply and feels good on my skin. I see the difference since I started using it. People comment on my skin and say it looks bright and smooth
The change in my skin is visible and I get compliments on my glow!

avis.titre: Surprised – this needs to be under the moisture surge
avis.texte: I didn't know that the glow serum went under my moisture surge gel. I have changed my routine now. It did sting a little one clean skin but only for a few days. Waiting to see a long-term effect because I only used it a week.

This serum saved my skin through dry cold Michigan winter, my skin soaks it right up , honestly it use it everywhere, even on my hair scalp when it feels dry . It's gentle for sensitive skin but also powerful for hydration. Love it great product

I love this product so much, not only is it super hydrating and smells so good but it doesn't break me out and gives me the perfect glow. It's super hydrating and my after shower routine go-to. Highly recommend!
Great serum. Feels great! I haven't used it long enough to see results.
I'm 46 and love the Clinique Moisture Surge Active Glow Serum! Lightweight, absorbs fast, and gives a soft glow without setting into fine lines. Hydrating, smooth, and perfect under makeup.

I love this serum! I apply this serum under my daytime moisturizer and I love how it makes my skin feel moisturized and glowy. You can see how your skin just absorbs it. Highly recommend this for dry skin.

Over the years I had strayed from Clinique to other brands, mostly because Clinique has a habit of changing or discontinuing products. This serum has lured me back. I received a sample and was amazed at how quickly I saw results. I bought the full size, and it targets every concern I have, even my hyperpigmentation.
This helps to add a layer of moisture onto my skin as well as has a smoothing factor to my skins surface.
I like this hydrating serum. It goes on easily and absorbs quickly. So far my skin feels hydrated and even though I have sensitive skin, I have had no irritation!
I was talked into this product by sales help. Not sure I have enough coaching on how to use it, or why I should use it.
This product goes on smoothly & easily. My skin appears brighter & a bit more radiant after using for a several months.
Fantastic face serum! Leaves skin glowing and gives a natural look. Love wearing it alone with no makeup and gives a natural glow .

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am a fan of this active glow serum from Clinique! It is very moisturizing and has a pleasant scent. It doesn't make my makeup peel (one of my biggest pet peeves)!

I've been using the Glow Serum for several months. I use it before Moisture Surge. I recently added the Clinique Vitamin C drops to the Moisture Surge, and let me tell you...what a combo! These are my must have skincare products. 10/10 would recommend!

I was gifted this and, honestly, used it on a whim. Now I use it twice a day every day! My face feels moisturized all day and I live in West Texas where I it is super dry! I top it with DDML and I am set!
This was recommended to me and I was skeptical about it because I have dry and sensitive skin in my 40s. It was a game changer. My skin feels so nice and it's more hydrating than ever.
I would buy this product again. Was satisfied with my service and purchase. Would recommend to family and friends.

avis.titre: Absorbs Fast for A Three-In-One Formula!
avis.texte: I have been in love with Clinique for years now and I love this very light formula. It really smooths out the skin and brightens dark post acne marks.
I have extremely dry skin and have never found a product like this one that keeps my skin moisturized, even under makeup! My skin looks good feels good and i will NEVER stop using this!!

I got a trial size of this in a gift set and had to buy the full size immediately bc of its efficacy on the skin. I put this on the apples of my cheeks, tip of my nose, and tip of my chin and I get to keep this dewy glow all day over makeup or by itself, you can't go wrong.

avis.titre: On my second bottle of this product!
avis.texte: Love this product. I'm on my second bottle. Keeps my skin so hydrated. It's also perfect for under my makeup. Gives me a beautiful dewy look all day!
Received this as a sample. Love this Serum. Will purchase again

I'm a regular Clinique user. My mom decided to gift me a bunch of products of my choosing. One of them was the active glow serum. After 3 days of using it in my morning and evening routine I noticed my skin quite literally had more of a glow to it. I'm 60, have worked outside the last 20 years. My skin isn't great. This made it go from looking dull to glowing.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Im really enjoying this serum! It's super hydrating and feels great on my skin. The ingredients are impressive, which makes me feel good about using it. My only issue is the scent; it smells like rubbing alcohol to me. Because of that, I'll be using it on my skin rather than my face. The packaging is adorable and I appreciate the opportunity to try it. Thank you, Influenster!

avis.titre: Great for skin tone, glow, texture
avis.texte: I've purchased this twice so far and plan to continue using every day. I needed something to help with additional exfoliation and hydration in the morning, and this was the best product I've added to my routine to help my makeup sit nicer. There is a gentle exfolating effect but it doesn't irritate my skin.
I can really feel a difference in my skin. I have their peptide serum as well, but I feel this one is better.

This was a small-size tube, part of a Clinique skincare kit. I'm happy to have tried it because it gave my mature dry skin more moisture and a wonderful smooth feel. I didn't find it to be irritating, as I had with another Clinique serum some time ago. In my case though, I think it gave my skin a little too much "glow" as I already have some redness (and use the Redness Solutions line of Clinique products), so it probably isn't the most appropriate for me. Otherwise, I think it is a great addition to the Clinique skincare line.

avis.titre: Moisture Surge Active Glow Serum - Wonderful!
avis.texte: This is the first time I ever tried a serum and I, honestly, have to say that I should have started a while ago. It is the absolute BEST product that has come along in the Clinique collection. Honestly, it would not hurt to start using this if you're 35 and, certainly, older. Yes, it is pricey but, you do not need very much. It can be used along with the Moisture Surge overnight mask or your Clinique Moisturizing Lotion while doing your normal make-up routine. It feels good on your skin and it does a great job to make mature skin seem/look more youthful. I highly recommend and I seldom give any product the highest rating. Thank you!

I purchased this serum for my daughter, who is a dry skin beauty in her 20s. It is a super luxurious serum thot feels amazingly smooth going on and makes her skin look SO glowy and healthy. And it doesn't cause her any breakouts. I will definitely be repurchasing this serum for myself as soon as I get through my other serums. It's so yummy. Clinique does it again!

avis.titre: Works well for guys! Low shine.
avis.texte: As a guy I like that this Glow Moisturizer makes my skin look refreshed & healthy without the extremely high glow/sheen or wet look some products provide. The smell is ... different .. but not something that you can smell all day long.
Very disappointed in the serum had to stop using it. My checks broke out in red blotches. Use Moisture Surge Mask and Replenishing Hydrator for years, and love how the products make my skin feel.
This product has made my face feel amazing! The fine lines are disappearing!
It feels soft and light on the face. It gives good moisture and glow.

I don't tend to gravitate toward moisture surge products as I don't like the consistency/texture. However, this has been a great morning serum. I let it dry prior to putting on my SPF moisturizer and don't get any pilling.
Started using and after a week I saw and felt more supple skin! Glowing and youthful. Absolutely love.

I've been a Clinique user for over 25 years now. I thought this serum would be good, but, I was so wrong. An OTC (over the counter) serum works a lot better than this one. I am disappointed about this.

Now ive been using this product for a few weeks and had to review. My skin type is dry-combonation skin girlie that loves makeup. When the season change so did my skin being on the dryer side. Looked for a aerum that would actually hydrate, add moisture and works well under makeup. This actually did the job on combination with the moisturizer. If you're looking for a hydrating serum look no further. This is it!!!!!

The serum I have used for years no longer exist so I had to shop for a new one. I tried the drug store brands and HATED how they feel. I don't recall how I heard about this serum but I gave it a try. I LOVE HOW IT FEELS ON MY SKIN. I use it under my eyes. I have to say this with the Moisturizer DOES make my skin look brighter.

avis.titre: Best skin care line for mature skin
avis.texte: I am almost 50 and you would never know it. Moisture surge intense products hydrate and keep my skin looking youthful. Forever my fave

I have been using this for about a week, and the difference in my skin has been incredible. Paired with dramatically different moisturizer and the effect is smooth, glowing skin. I've tried many serums and this is a favorite by far. It does go on tacky at first, but layered with moisturizer it melts into my skin.
I love this moisture surge. I use it after the exfoliation, it plumps mu skin

I didn't want to add another step to skincare but my skin became so dry as the weather got cold. This product is easy to use with the dropper and allows the skin to become smooth and hydrated when followed with moisturizer. In a couple of days my skin turned around. I'll keep using it through the winter and hope the good results continue.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This serum is fantastic! First of all I love that it is fragrance free. My skin is super sensitive so it's important to me that my skincare products are sensitive skin friendly. I also love the way this makes my skin feel so hydrated after each use. I like to apply it before my makeup so that my skin is nice and hydrated before applying products. Definitely would recommend!

I love moisture surge, especially after a peel or exfoliation. I also use it to apply foundation smoothly by mixing the two to apply. This added serum reduces the need for a separate serum, so I really love having this product.

If you have oily skin that gets flaky in winter or dry this helps alot! And no breakouts. Dont put near your eyes bc it does melt and goes into eyes and really burns. I usually put cheeks below but really hydrates!
I received a sample. I was disappointed in the smell and tacky feel of this product. I have used many different Clinique products over the past 30+ years, this product was a huge disappointment.

I used it once earlier this week and the next morning my skin was super stinging. I haven't used it since and my skin is peeling in places. I've been smearing moisture surge all over my face to ease the dryness. While I can see the benefits of it for someone with less mature skin than I, it's like retinol times ten for me.

This product pills a lot on my face and neck, even when i only use the other moisture surge products for face prep. The product pills on its own even without the application of makeup. When applying makeup over it you must work quick which is a negative for me as i isually do my eyes first and i find that repeat application of the moisturizer is deleterious. Would highly recommend something else especially if you have combination or oily skin.

avis.titre: Good for my very sensitive skin
avis.texte: My 56 year old skin is sensitive; no retinoids, retinols, or high percentage vitamin c. They all make me itch, peel and sometimes swell. The lactic acid in this product I can tolerate, and the glycerin is quite nice. It feels a bit tacky until it dries, but I wake up in the morning with smoother, softer skin. I have to take a break every 4th night, and use moisturizer only. It is not fading my dark spots much, but it has helped with smoothing the texture of my skin. Also, as serums go, it is not tremendously overpriced, and I appreciate that. I will repurchase.

avis.titre: More transpercy is needed regarding vitamin C
avis.texte: I got this bottle not via promotion like so many seem to have who have written reviews, I am an actual customer who paid for it. First off I really do enjoy the overall look of the product however looks only mean so much, quality of the product is what matters. I found the serum was very milky and smooth and it did make my skin look more hydrated. I did get a few deep pimples on my chin the first week of use , not sure if it was from this serum or not. The serum layered nicely with other products and sun screen. There was no pilling which is huge for me because I hate pilling. I had that issue with Clinique's super charged hydrating serum so was relieved this serum didn't have that problem. All in all a decent serum if you are looking for something that hydrates nicely and plays well with other products. My issue though and why I only give three stars is Clinique's complete lack of transparency when it comes to vitamin C. For vitamin C to be effective you want at least 10 percent. Also 15 -20 percent can be hard for people with sensitive skin to handle. They claim their secretiveness as far as percentage is due to "proprietary reasons". I don't get that because there are plenty of serums on the market that reveal their vitamin C percentage. Just seems deceitful to me, as if there isn't really all that much in the serum. Due to that I feel like I cant really discontinue the Vitamin C serum I am using as I know that has sufficient amount for effectiveness.For that reason I am o

avis.titre: This is a repeat purchase. Love it!
avis.texte: I have used Clinique products with Hyaluronic Acid for at least 45 years. I love the Moisture Surge line, and this serum works wonderfully.

I was very excited to try the Moisture Surge Active Glow Serum since I found other Moisture Surge products to be effective. Given the product name, I expected it to give the same plump but with an added "glow". It had absolutely NO impact on my skin. None. Totally INEFFECTIVE. I would not recommend to purchase.
This product goes on easily, it absorbs quickly and my skin feels amazing and hydrated. Highly recommend!
I received this product form Influenstet for my honest review. The product went on smoothly, but felt sticky for a little. It has little to no scent making it easy to apply.
Just make sure you're not over using it if you have sensitive skin

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been a fan of Clinique since I first got into skincare, and this serum is no exception! I have dry sensitive skin so I'm always looking for something that hydrates without irritating my skin, and this does just that! My skin looks plump & glowing!

avis.titre: AwesomeNESS in the prettiest of Bottles!!!!!!!
avis.texte: I've been a long time Clinique user! As a teenager, Clinique was my first skin care routine and at 44, i still cant get away. But this here, this Moisture Surge Serum is a game changer. I've had the moisturizer, the mask, and hydro-infused lotion. Its been only a few days and when i tell you my skin is glowing and plumped and just as pretty as it can be! I was using Este Lauder but this price point and the benefits, i don't miss night repair or its price!!!!!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love the glass packaging—it feels heavy and high-end. The serum itself is super soft, gentle on my skin, and layers well under makeup. The scent is light and pleasant. Definitely a favorite!

avis.titre: Makes my skin glow and soft
avis.texte: This serum is amazing! Was suffering from dryness and make up separation and this serum made my skin care routing much easier.
I clean my face, apply toner, wait a bit apply serum, wait a bit apply moisture surge. At age 72 my skin looks great

I got a deluxe sample of this to try. I've had very clear skin on my forehead for a couple years. I tried this product ONLY on my forehead to test it out. Woke up today with white heads, black heads and swollen deep pimples only where I put this product. It's a NOPE for me.
This item is too small for the price of y'all charged for this. It should be a little bit bigger and it's kind of watery. It need to be a little bit more condensed but other than that it works OK.

avis.titre: Helps My Other Moisture Surge Products Work Better
avis.texte: For me, this is a great substitute for Clarifying Lotion, which contain alcohol denat and witch hazel that cause skin irritation. Due to its mild exfoliation, this serum helps my other products absorb into my skin and improves overall moisturization. Hyaluronic acid is a plus. My skin is sensitive and thinning as I age, so I use it only once daily, in the evening. I am cautious about using vitamin C and lactic acid because they can cause stinging and burning, but with once-a-day application followed by moisture surge cream, this hasn't happened. I use sunscreen daily to keep my skin even more protected. I appreciate that Clinique does not use fragrance in their products!

Gets crumbly under foundation (and yes I waited ten mins or longer before applying foundation). Plus, it's supposed to stop my foundation from creasing and it doesn't. My previous Vitamin C serum works much better.
I love how it leaves my skin so glowing. I would definitely recommend this serum.

avis.titre: It does makes my skin glow!
avis.texte: I recently purchased this serum and immediately felt the difference. I told the Clinique representative that I needed something to help me with my T zone, she recommended this to me and I felt exactly as specified: moisturize and even exfoliated lightly. Love it so far!
I love this so much. You can definitely feel the hydration and your skin looks so glowy. Love the texture of this. Will definitely purchase again.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Very moisturizing! I was surprised as someone with oily skin how well it worked for my skin! Stacked nicely with sunscreen. This probably works better in the winter time when the temperatures aren't so high/humid.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have rosacea and from time to time like to have a bare face but have been using this product to give me a bit of a glow and I love it! I have used it without makeup and with makeup and it blends well.
Honestly, I did not notice a difference in my skin but it did make the skin glowy. I think its nice to apply it before the makeup.

avis.titre: Milky formula that causes breakout on rosacea skin
avis.texte: After using this produce I started breaking out and getting rosacea. Before I didn't have red skin and no acne. So expensive and what a waste of money. The bottle is nice. I don't like the milky texture and the smell.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First of all I love the packaging. It's definitely moisturizing but I think the moisture surge cream works a lot better. It's still a fun thing to add to my skincare routine!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The serum has a really nice, thin texture. I think the packaging is nice and simple to use, and every time I've used it my skin has felt softer immediately after, even under moisturizer. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin, so I consider it a win.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I tried this serum a handful of times, I have pretty normal skin, and have noticed a few things: this serum is incredibly easy to apply from the dropper, and it feels moisturizing,not greasy. It definitely gave a slight appearance of radiance thay hyaluronic acid and lactic acid will bring. I was dealing with a minor breakout already and for some reason, this did not seem to influence the affected area in a good way. I don't think it caused any kind of breakout, but I'm already dealing with one, I've noticed serums reallly don't add anything.

avis.titre: Didn't notice a difference in my skin
avis.texte: Gifted by Influenster. This product does not excited me currently. Perhaps I would have noticed more of a difference in my skin had I tried this serum in the winter. But not that the weather is warmer, my skin doesn't need as much hydration help. I also dislike the smell- it's a bit clinical and makes it slightly unenjoyable to use.

As a skincare girlie entering her summer era, Clinique telling me I can be glowing and hydrated by one product has me sold. It's a lightweight milky texture that settles into the skin easily and has a light fresh scent to it. It also contains AHA which lightly exfoliates my skin. I actually purchased a second bottle and use it with my morning vitamin C and it's made a huge impact on brightening my skin.

I absolutely love this product! I've been using it for three months now, and it's the only one I apply before my makeup. My skin feels soft all day long. I only use it once in the morning, and it has completely eliminated my dryness while feeling so light. I won't use anything else!
A serum that does what it says. Thank you Clinique for always having fragrance free skin care. My mature skin is brighter and softer.

After a couple months of a close friend recommending Clinique products to me, I caved and purchased multiple items, including their glow serum, the amount of hydration provided by any products in their moisture surge line is unreal, but this serum would have to be my favorite. I have not yet been disappointed by a Clinique product; I would 100% recommend.

I always prided myself on have a great face without any make up on, maybe I was too cocky, i tried the new serum and I woke up to a harsh reaction.. burning hives on both sides of my face… I lovd Clinique and have most of their products, so this a painful review to write but I feel like people should know..

I love this serum it's resurfacing without being too harsh I have sensitive skin so yea it really works for me now all that's needed is for Clinique to complete the Moisture Surge line and come out with a Moisture Surge Cleanser!!! Please !!!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like to examine skincare ingredients before trying a product. The first five ingredients are: water, glycerin, lactic acid, octyldodecyl myristate, and butylene glycol. Overall, these ingredients are quite good, but butylene glycol may not be suitable for those with sensitized skin. Personally, I have sensitive skin, and I found that it handles it well; I experienced a little redness but no burning sensation. Do I feel like I've gained amazing extra hydration? Not really. I probably won't purchase this product again, but it's certainly not the worst I've tried. I do appreciate that it contains lactic acid, which is great for chemical exfoliation. If you're looking for a mild exfoliant with some hydration, I would definitely recommend giving it a try.

avis.titre: Makes my Skin Glow and feel Hydrated
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Unfortunately my 4yr old miss placed my serum and I've searched all over for it but have still not had any luck but what I can tell you without needing a picture is that this serum was so good. It was hydrating which is what my skin needs. Almost reminded me of another brand similar to this. This left my skin feeling dewy. And the packaging I loved. Anything pink will catch my eye instantly. I will definitely purchase this product in the near future since I still haven't found it and my skin needs it!

avis.titre: Took care of the really dry areas
avis.texte: I've used Moisture Surge for years and now have found my new favorite in this serum! Won't be without it!

I really love this serum i give it 4 stars just because its a little too pricy for the amount but other than that its a really good serum. It is really glowy and last all day and night. Get it you wont regret it.

avis.titre: Product quickly dries and leaves you smooth
avis.texte: This glow serum has a light scent and is wonderful for quick results when you just need a one and done product. This serum comes with a glass applicator and works well for sensitive skin. I have severely sensitive skin and she does the trick. My makeup looks smoother after just 3 uses. I received this product complimentary from influencer for my honest review and I'll be back for my 2nd bottle. This is the before bed product I needed.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review.] I used this in combination with a red light mask, but I noticed some true-life changes. I don't know if it was this or the mask, but best believe I will be using this because it really made me feel fresh, youthful, and yes, glowing.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Glow and moisturize ! Your skin will love this serum. It is hydrating and leaves a sheen like luminosity that makes your skin look hydrated and glass-like. The packaging is cute and pink and the texture is smooth and silky. Worth the purchase!

I got this as a sample for purchasing clinique even better foundation and I have to say this is one of the best products I've used on my face. my skin is so soft. im a huge skin care junkie and I like to try new things. this is my number 1 so far. im in love
I love this serum feels so good when i apply it 🩷🩷🩷 good for sensitive skin
Tried this in store on the back of my hand and felt great! However it did make my makeup and skincare peel. Will be returning

It's an amazing serum. I use it for its exfoliation benefits. I have oily skin and it gives me the perfect amount of moisture as well as exfoliation. I used it thrice a week first and then once a week after that.

This is a fabulous serum! I use the whole Moisture Surge line, so I purchased the 1.7 oz. size. Of course, it's a great deal & I'm glad I did! This serum is gentle yet wildly effective. Important to me is that all of these products play well together & don't pill or feel heavy or goopy on my face. Thanks, Clinique!

I love this stuff it make my face dewy and glowing youthful. Week one my husband asked "are you doing something different, your face is glowing", 3 weeks later my hair dresser "did you get a facial recently or something you face looks dewy" and an employee at work at 6 weeks " i have to ask and I hope you don't think this weird but, what make up are you using your glowing" Nothing changed but, this product being introduced! Magic.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This serum is wonderful....moisturized my skin, gave me a beautiful glow. Did not cause any breakouts and I have sensitive, combination skin. I would recommend this product.

I've been using the Clinique Moisture Surge Active Glow Serum for a few weeks now, and I'm really enjoying the results. The serum has a lovely, lightweight texture that absorbs quickly into my skin without leaving a sticky residue.
